item.title: Simple RDS access
item.description: There are plenty of ways to access private RDS instances, and most need careful design. The one I use sometimes is simple: deploy it as a Helm chart inside a k8s cluster. Access to the RDS then depends on having access to the k8s cluster with the right RBAC. It’s not perfect, but it’s secure, quick to set up, and needs almost no maintenance. Here’s the basic idea: 1 socat TCP4-LISTEN:8888,fork TCP4:xxxxxxxx.
